newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine to maintain 40 percent key rate-c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine to maintain 40 percent key rate-c.bank.

text.p: Ukraine's central bank will maintain its 40 percent refinancing rate despite a promise to lower it on September 9, the bank chairman said.

"August inflation stood at 5.7 percent, and September inflation is forecast at 2.9 to 3.2 percent. This means the key rate falls within current inflation parameters," said Viktor Yushchenko told reporters late on Thursday.
The rate was lowered to 40 percent on July 2. It stood at 105 percent at the beginning of the year. --Natalya Zinets, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
